g.text: Designing zero-compromise systems from 32-bit RISC-V silicon to low-latency runtimes.

text.tspan: Engineering 32-bit RISC-V SoC silicon (RV32I RTL), FPGA synthesis & memory-safe runtimes.
Building sovereign local-first desktop spaces, privacy browsers & autonomous coding AI.

g.text: Complete Offline-First Desktop Environment & Application Suite
A local-first desktop with integrated browser, encrypted notes, calendar, media player,
documents vault, radio, weather, news feeds, file utilities & zero-leak privacy controls.
Native tracker protection, isolated session containers, fine-grained permission controls,
real-time privacy dashboard, secure downloads & localized encrypted browsing history.
A lightweight coding AI runtime connecting to local LLMs or external APIs. Operates
on real codebases with sandboxed tool execution & deterministic workspace mutation.
Lightning-fast video/audio conversion, modern compression, deep metadata extraction,
subtitle demuxing/generation, batch pipeline execution & forensic container inspection.
Custom 32-Bit RISC-V Microcontroller SoC & RTL Subsystems
RV32I CPU core, boot ROM, SRAM controller, system bus, GPIO, UART, SPI, I²C,
hardware timers, nested interrupts, bare-metal firmware, GHDL sim & FPGA target.
Passed Inter-Collegiate Test for Final Year Project Grant
Event Lead for Inter-Collegiate Tech Summit
